sentences.text: Monoenantiornis is a monotypic genus, meaning it contains only one species, M. sihedangia, which belongs to the subclass Enantiornithes.
The parent group for this genus is Enantiornithes.
The genus was described by Hu and O'Connor in 2017.
This extinct bird genus inhabited China during the Cretaceous period.
Fossils of M. sihedangia date to the Aptian stage of the Early Cretaceous.
The animal existed between 121.4 and 113.2 million years ago.
